chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Keeping the party going; the girl who wanted to dance
summary: He says he only stopped the men, the party carried on, and they were talked out of finding the tipster; the chorus girl wanted to dance ballroom but neither could.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: So after you beat these two guys off --
I don't beat nobody up, didn't beat a soul. I didn't beat a soul.
I just stopped them from doing what they wanted to do. They didn't get in, they didn't hurt nobody -- hit that girl, they wouldn't have gotten away with that if I could have helped it.
And then what happened, you went back into the party after that?

I was still in the party, the party was still going on. They're outside the room, man. We're in the other room. Just shut the door and the party still stays. We didn't close the party on that account, God bless. All we did was just play the victrola and all like nothing happened. But I'm thinking about -- we're going out and what shall we do. Keep a cool head. We kept a cool head.
The next day we got the feeling we'll look for this Alan, Alan Walker, he was the guy we want to find because he was

setting these guys up and then Eddie Scarf talked us out of it and I'll never forget that. So imagine going through that? Now this girl, this girl now, this same girl I've been telling you about, she was in the party. She was the one who wanted to dance ballroom with me, I told her I don't do no ballroom dancing. I'm a tap dancer, not a ballroom dancer, don't know how to dance. And Buck don't know how to dance either. So neither one of us knew how to dance. Do you understand? So what, is she going to make us dance? So imagine taking one of the girls to dance with her? Can you imagine -- I guess you can imagine it, dancing with the girls, or any girl, you know -- smelling like a rose garden. That's what they smelled like. Got all kinds of perfume and everything and beautiful outfits they had on. Wouldyou do it, huh? You wouldn't want to kiss one of them, would ya? Thank you. Thank you. Any ordinary man would. Any ordinary man would. You understand? If he's human. And

look at the age now. Look at the age you've got -- more gullible now at that age than you would be at manhood, you know what I mean? Got to get caught. Got to get caught. What do you think Buck and Bubbles climbed from, huh? Climbed from being able to evade. We evaded all the possibilities of doing -- well, I won't go into that. Let you have that.
